title: REDI-NET SW-2 Swab Processing
author: REDI-NET Consortium
materials: Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash on the instrument.
Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash on the instrument.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Tubes
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of ATL-DX buffer and 20 µL Proteinase K to the bead tubes.

steps.title: Add Samples and Controls
steps.instruction: Prepare sample tubes and control tubes for the batch.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample swab in the bead tube with ATL buffer and Proteinase K; use sterile scissors to cut off swab heads or transfer pre-cut heads with forceps.
Positive Control: Transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, 100 µL EBV, and 100 µL DENV-1 standard into a tube, then add 250 µL ATL-DX buffer and 20 µL proteinase K.
Negative Control: Prepare a bead tube with 500 µL ATL-DX buffer and 20 µL proteinase K.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in a thermomixer at 1400 rpm, 56 °C, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mechanical Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform bead beating using the Bullet Blender.

substeps.instruction: Refill the dry ice compartment of the Bullet Blender if necessary.
Load all samples into the Bullet Blender.
Set speed to 12 and time to 3, then press Start.
Let samples settle for 00:01:00 in the Bullet Blender, then repeat the beating step.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bead tubes with lysate at 12000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Configure KingFisher Instrument
steps.instruction: Prepare the instrument based on the model being used (Flex or Duo Prime).

substeps.instruction: For KingFisher Flex: Ensure program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash is loaded. Set up Tip Comb (Pos 7), Elution Plate (Pos 6, 75 µL Nuclease-free water), Wash 4 (Pos 5, 750 µL 100% ethanol), Wash 3 (Pos 4, 750 µL 80% ethanol), Wash 2 (Pos 3, 700 µL Buffer AW2), and Wash 1 (Pos 2, 700 µL Buffer AW1).

For KingFisher Duo Prime: Ensure program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash is loaded. Set up Sample Plate (Row A: Lysate/lysis buffer 985 µL; Row B: Buffer AW1 700 µL; Row C: Buffer AW2 700 µL; Row D: 80% ethanol 750 µL; Row E: 100% ethanol 750 µL; Row F: Tip comb). Set up Elution Strip (Row A: Nuclease-free water 75 µL).

steps.title: Prepare Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate and add binding reagents to the sample wells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 290 µL supernatant (without particle carryover) to the sample plate/row.
Prepare a master mix (with 10% overage) containing 135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, and 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G per sample.
Mix the master mix by slow inversion or on a Hula mixer for 2 min to avoid foaming.
Add 695 µL of the mixture to each sample, bringing the total volume per well to 985 µL.
Start the run and load plates/strips into position when prompted.
If using KingFisher Duo Prime, keep the door open during extraction to prevent ethanol vapor contamination.
Once the run is completed (~35 minutes), immediately remove the elution plate, cover it, or transfer eluate to final storage tubes.

steps.title: Measure Nucleic Acid Concentration
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA and RNA using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: DNA Measurement: Mix 3 µL total nucleic acid with 197 µL of 1x HS dsDNA Qubit Assay (final volume 200 µL). Vortex 5-10 seconds and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature.
RNA Working Solution: Prepare a mix of 199 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay buffer and 1 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay Dye per sample.
RNA Measurement: Mix 197 µL of the RNA working solution with 3 µL of sample in a 0.6 mL tube. Vortex 5-10 seconds and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Sample Storage or Testing
steps.instruction: Proceed to testing or store the extracted nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Proceed with testing following REDI-NET SOP SW-4 Swab Testing.
Short-term storage: Store at -20 °C for less than 2 weeks.
Long-term storage: Store at -80 °C following REDI-NET SOP SW-3 Swab Storage.
